headline: Iran war: US, Iran announce tentative peace deal
summary: Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif announced a tentative peace deal between the US and Iran, with a signing ceremony set for June 19. Both sides would terminate military operations, including in Lebanon.
why: Conflict involving Iran affects global oil supply routes, energy prices and risk sentiment across markets, which makes any settlement a major macro event for investors.
why_moved: The announced deal to end military operations reduces fears of supply disruption in the region, which tends to weigh on crude prices and lift risk appetite.
